title: Xdrip+ cant sync when is connected to 3G/4G
symptom: xDrip+ master does not send data to followers when connected to 3G/4G/Data, but works fine on WiFi. Problem appeared after xdrip or MIUI update.
cause: In one case, the issue was caused by an incorrect APN setting on the device.
fix: Correcting the APN setting resolved the issue for one user.
evidence_quote: Based on the last one I checked the watch coverage and I found out there was a “APN” setting that was not correct.
